batch_execution_order: Batch 1 (EC, 6 items, EASY) — Quick wins, COSO principles are well-documented
Batch 2 (ED Group 1, 8 items, EASY) — Ethics/communication topics have rich scenario potential
Batch 3 (ED Group 2, 8 items, MODERATE) — Controls design and cost-benefit scenarios
Batch 4 (FC Group 1, 12 items, MODERATE) — Foundational tech governance topics
Batch 5 (FC Group 2, 16 items, MODERATE) — Analytics and cybersecurity in depth
Batch 6 (FC Group 3, 19 items, COMPLEX) — Emerging technologies requiring domain research
Batch 7 (FD Group 1, 16 items, MODERATE) — Data management and infrastructure
Batch 8 (FD Group 2, 18 items, COMPLEX) — Advanced tech governance scenarios

rationale.easy_replacement: COSO/controls topics: well-documented frameworks with extensive scenario material available. Authoring primarily involves selecting appropriate business context and crafting realistic distractor traps.
rationale.moderate_replacement: Established technology concepts: data governance, analytics, cybersecurity, ERP. Topics are definable but require current industry knowledge for authentic scenario design.
rationale.complex_replacement: Emerging/narrow tech: blockchain, AI/ML governance, NLP, RPA, predictive models. Topics require research into current practices and careful calibration of cognitive level to match CMA Part 1 expectations.
rationale.structural_notes: All items carry DL-026 (empty non-CC ExplanationWrong slots) because they are metadata-only shells. The EC/ED items (22) also carry DL-013 boilerplate contamination. These structural defects resolve automatically when new content is authored from scratch. No item needs separate cleanup before replacement.
